title: The Classified Soviet Program That Found a Signal From Inside Earth
hook: In the 1970s, Soviet scientists picked up a repeating radio pulse coming from deep within the planet—and the government buried the report immediately.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines Cold War secrecy with a terrifying impossibility—a signal from inside Earth—creating instant conspiracy appeal.

title: The Asteroid That Changed Course to Avoid Earth—Then Came Back
hook: It swerved away like it knew we were watching—then looped around and returned, as if it had unfinished business with our planet.
why_this_can_go_viral: Attribution of intent to a lifeless rock triggers deep paranoia—viewers will ask 'was it alive? was it guided?'

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That Is a Cosmic Silent Room
hook: Imagine a universe where every intelligent civilization is isolated in a soundproof cell—and no one ever cries for help because they don't know they're trapped.
why_this_can_go_viral: Dark psychological twist on the Fermi Paradox—feels like a horror story with real science backing, highly shareable.

title: The Dark Matter Cloud That Slowed Down Time in a Nebula
hook: A nebula where time ticks slower than anywhere else in the galaxy—and dark matter is the only thing that could explain the cosmic time warp.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time distortion is instantly fascinating—viewers love anything that challenges their understanding of reality.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Was a Planet's Death Scream
hook: It wasn't a star exploding—it was a planet being torn apart, and its destruction sent a scream across the galaxy that we still don't fully understand.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personification of a planetary death as a scream creates intense emotional hook—combines tragedy with cosmic scale.

title: The Secret NASA Program That Found a Planet Orbiting Nothing
hook: A planet with no star, no sun, no light—just drifting in eternal darkness, and NASA tracked it for years before calling it 'anomalous' and shutting down the project.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a hidden planet in perpetual night taps into cosmic horror and the fear of unseen threats.

title: The Comet That Carried a Signal Older Than the Universe
hook: A signal encoded in the ice of a comet—and it predates the Big Bang itself, as if it was sent from before time began.
why_this_can_go_viral: Defies known physics and invites wild speculation about a universe that existed before ours—super high curiosity.

title: The Black Hole That Ejected a Ship-Shaped Asteroid
hook: An asteroid in perfect ship shape came flying out of a black hole's event horizon—and its trajectory suggests it was launched with intent.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests intelligent construction near a black hole—feeds alien megastructure and ancient astronaut theories.

title: The Dark Matter Storm That Caused a Mass Extinction on Earth
hook: When dark matter storms hit Earth, they may have triggered the extinction cycles—and according to new data, another storm is due soon.
why_this_can_go_viral: Links an invisible cosmic force directly to human extinction—creates urgency and existential dread.

title: The Classified ESA Document on an Asteroid That Had a Door
hook: The European Space Agency photographed an asteroid with a perfectly rectangular opening—and the file was classified before anyone could analyze it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The word 'door' triggers immediate alien architecture speculation—high click-through and discussion potential.

title: The Supernova That Left a Ghost Image of Its Planet
hook: After a supernova, astronomers found a perfect silhouette of a planet burned into the expanding debris—like a photograph from hell.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual concept of a 'ghost planet' imprinted on death cloud is haunting and cinematic—high shareability.

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That Is a Cosmic Data Deletion
hook: What if the reason we see no other civilizations is because the universe deletes any species that becomes too intelligent—like a cosmic trash bin?
why_this_can_go_viral: Dark, almost dystopian take on Fermi—feels like a sci-fi horror concept that could actually be real.

title: The Strange Signal That Translated Into a Map of a Black Hole's Interior
hook: A signal from nowhere translated into a perfect map of the inside of a black hole—as if someone already went in and sent back the layout.
why_this_can_go_viral: Defies known physics—suggests survival into a black hole or alien engineering beyond comprehension.

title: The Asteroid That Had a Perfectly Circular Crater—Drilled by Something
hook: An asteroid with a crater so perfectly round it looked manufactured—like a core sample taken by an intelligence we never saw.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests unseen cosmic activity—like someone is sampling asteroids for unknown purposes.

title: The Secret US Program That Detected a Signal From the Moon's Core
hook: Apollo seismometers picked up a rhythmic pulsing from deep inside the Moon—and the Pentagon classified the data as 'non-natural origin'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Moon mysteries always perform well—add classified government secrecy and it's a viral cocktail.

title: The Comet That Left a Trail of Liquid That Shouldn't Exist in Space
hook: A comet dripping a liquid that shouldn't exist in the vacuum of space—and when analyzed, it contained amino acids with no known origin.
why_this_can_go_viral: Breaks fundamental physics—liquid in vacuum implies unknown forces or artificial containment.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Was a Beacon for a Collapsed Star
hook: A gamma ray burst pulsed in a repeating pattern—like a lighthouse for a dead star, guiding something toward its remains.
why_this_can_go_viral: The lighthouse metaphor creates a haunting image—suggests intentionality in cosmic destruction.

title: The Rogue Planet That Had a Frozen Ocean With No Star to Warm It
hook: A planet with a frozen ocean in eternal darkness—somehow still liquid beneath the ice, heated by something we can't detect.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mysterious internal heat source on a dead world implies unknown geology—or something alive.

title: The Black Hole That Emitted a Signal That Matched a Primordial Language
hook: A signal from a black hole matched the phonetics of a language spoken 10,000 years ago on Earth—as if the universe learned to speak before we did.
why_this_can_go_viral: Connects ancient human culture to cosmic signals—creates a bridge that feels both mystical and terrifying.

title: The Supernova That Was a Message From a Dying Civilization
hook: A supernova that pulsed in a pattern too precise to be natural—as if a civilization chose to end itself in a final broadcast across the galaxy.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suicide as a cosmic broadcast is heartbreaking and terrifying—high emotional impact and discussion potential.

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That Is a Cosmic Prison Built by a Godlike Entity
hook: What if the silence is not because we're alone, but because someone built a wall around our solar system—and we're inside a cage, not a cradle?
why_this_can_go_viral: Most viral concept—transforms the gentle 'cradle of humanity' into a terrifying cage guarded by an unseen warden.
